UPDATE user_svc.profiles SET
                full_name = $2, nik_encrypted = $3, nik_last4 = $4,
                education_level = $5, gender = $6, birth_date = $7,
                address_line = $8, country_code = $9,
                province_id = $10, regency_id = $11, district_id = $12, village_id = $13,
                updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1
